_comment: M28.11 add_custom_event_input post-apply soak. Duplicates BP_NodeZoo (Actor BP with declared CustomEvent `Ping` in EventGraph + variables + ExecutionSequence) into a scratch path and appends a string input parameter `Channel` to the Ping event's K2Node_CustomEvent::UserDefinedPins. Soak asserts md5 stability across 2 rounds, proving SeedGuidFromJoined(':custom_event:Ping:userpin:Channel:out') overrides FGuid::NewGuid() called by UEdGraphPin::CreatePin inside K2Node_EditablePinBase::CreateUserDefinedPin. skip_inspect=true because user-defined pins on CustomEvent nodes surface as inputs into the event handler body but DeepDumpRenderer's existing K2Node_CustomEvent rendering doesn't itemize them in a grep-friendly form the inspect gate would catch.
